q: What was the most common cause of accidents?
What percentage of accidents were caused by broken glass?
Choose two causes and suggest a lab rule that would prevent each one.
Hot equipment: leave it to cool on a heat-proof mat and test with the back of the hand near it. Chemical in the eye: wear safety glasses. Slips and trips: bags under the bench, wipe spills.
A school wants to halve its accidents. Use the data to argue which two rules it should focus on first.

Hot equipment (26) and broken glass (18) make 44 of 80 accidents, more than half. So focus on letting equipment cool and carrying and storing glass carefully; this alone could halve the total if those accidents stopped.
